what: First run of the cooperative timer-0 sampler: does the firmware survive being sampled?
board: 20.16 MHz Courier V.Everything, ID_SDL v4.03d, supervisor 7.4.16, DSP 3.1.2, idle and on hook
method: courier_emu.cooperative_probe. 54-byte ISR placed at 0x3000 (28 write commands with --assume-zero, 5 s), hooked on IVT vector 8 with T0CON.INT enabled, left running, then disarmed and the ring read back with ATGLK2= page dumps.
the question: Every previous probe took the machine over and the ADM707's 1.6 s watchdog reset the board. This one does bounded work per 5 ms tick and irets, leaving the supervisor running to feed its own watchdog. Does that actually hold?

result.held_for: 9.3 s armed, AT answered on every one of 8 probes at ~1 s intervals
result.reset: none - the sentinel written to 0x2200, outside the image, survived the whole run
result.rate: 1902 samples / ~9.5 s = 200 Hz, exactly timer 0's 5 ms tick

means: The cooperative design works: the run is not watchdog-bounded, and the firmware is undisturbed.
The sampled values match the idle column of docs/asic-port-map.md exactly, so the ISR is reading the ports it thinks it is.
One distinct value per port is the correct result for an idle on-hook modem. This run demonstrates the instrument, not a finding.
limits: It samples what the 80186 can reach. It cannot read the DSP's internal data memory: 0x0390 and the rest of the resident's state sit behind the mailbox, and the 121-entry dispatch table has no handler that reads an address and mails it back (scanned in IDSDL302.ROM). Sampling DSP-side cells during a call still needs a DSP-side mechanism that does not exist yet.

The port set is the risk. The default is the status/handshake group only, because reading the mailbox data pair or the 0x60/0x62 stream may consume words the firmware is waiting for and corrupt the call being observed.
Disarm is mandatory and has no safety net. The takeover probes were cleaned up by the watchdog reset; nothing resets this one, so the hook and the placed image persist until disarmed or power cycled.
next: Arm it, place a call, disarm, and read the ring - the same run with something actually happening.
